card.name: Change from baseline in trial tables
card.fires_on: The word "from" (or the following "baseline") right after "mean change" or "change in [measure]" in clinical trial results. Also fires on a few nearby spots such as the gap after "greater than" before a QTc value.

modes.label: Change from baseline
modes.description: "from" or "baseline" in phrases reporting mean change from baseline of a lab value, weight or QTc.

modes.label: Shifts from baseline
modes.description: Partway through "baseline" in shift-table or change-from-baseline wording.
